items.prompt: The independent loop starts at z=12 (1100) and parity=0. It repeatedly applies z &= z-1 and toggles parity. Which trace is correct?

options.why: This sets bits instead of clearing the lowest set bit; the loop would not reach zero by this trace.
This is right shifting, not z AND (z-1). It counts bit positions traversed, not set bits cleared.
One operation clears only the lowest set bit. 1100 still has the higher set bit afterward.
1100 AND 1011 is 1000; 1000 AND 0111 is zero. Two toggles return parity to zero.

items.explanation: 1100 AND 1011 is 1000; 1000 AND 0111 is zero. Two toggles return parity to zero.
